description: Pixel age from Present() submission to YOLO11n forward-pass completion on CUDA, per capture path. Medians across 3 passes of 8 s per path; min/max are the per-pass extremes. Every path verified before timing.
machine: Machine B: Intel UHD capture, RTX 4060 Laptop inference, 2560x1600 at 165 Hz

model.output: raw detector predictions; no NMS or detection postprocessing timed
model.weights_note: Official Ultralytics v8.3.0 release asset; byte size matches the release (5,613,764). GitHub publishes no digest for this asset.
model.placement: all 239 nodes on CUDAExecutionProvider; CPU fallback disabled
model.official_onnx_not_used_because: The published yolo11n.onnx (sha256 634279b4...) is opset 22; ONNX Runtime 1.30 has no CUDA MaxPool kernel at that opset, so 7 of 246 nodes fall back to the CPU and ORT's spinning CPU thread pool dominates the CPU column. It ranked the paths the same way in a single trial pass.

rapidshot-direct.unavailable: CrossAdapterRequired: no CUDA device owns the adapter this frame was captured on. On a hybrid laptop that is expected: capture runs on the integrated GPU and CUDA only sees the discrete one. The frame has to cross adapters first — see native.cross_adapter_transfer() and ROADMAP § 6.1.
